message.content: Starting the hunt — sampling random traffic to map the space.
Random probing found a clearance violation — now I'll dig into the failing trace.
Hypothesis: emergency preemption cuts yellow short and skips clearance. Shrinking to isolate it.
Shrunk to a minimal case — replaying to confirm it still breaks the rules.
Replay confirmed — inspecting the violation point and the seconds before it.
North-south is green while east-west waits — checking the signal history leading up to the switch.
The switch jumped straight from yellow to green — looking earlier to see when yellow began.
Ledger - open: emergency preempts to green skipping yellow/all-red; ruled out: none yet. Intervention test: same shrunk scenario minus emergency should pass.
Counterfactual passes without the emergency — submitting the grounded report.
